notes: «أبي - رحمه الله -» at the head is the compiler's own father (relation); the blessing is not part of the surface
«أخيه علي بن سيف» and «أبيه سيف بن عميرة» are relation plus name: one link each, surface the name alone (rule 7)
«قلت لأبي عبد الله عليه السلام» names the Imam after the chain, in his own speech: last link (owner ruling 2); «عليه السلام» is left out
